item.title: Pulse 2.0.0
item.description:
## Changes
- chore: 2.0.0 — Knowledge 2: two-tier learning, Brief reminders, Double Tap, knowledge graph - fix(graph): no twin dot for an entity that has its own page - feat(graph): canvas-shaped ring, fit on open, night-sky look - feat(graph): co-source edges and entity satellites from the knowledge store - fix(knowledge): repo window keys hash the folder path - fix(knowledge): engine safety — retryable triage failures, no page tails lost, deny list on every cloud path - fix(brief): deny list on every cloud send, live switch, failed builds keep cards, bounded actions, calendar snapshots supersede, atomic notification replace - fix(knowledge): a capped run gives every source a turn - fix(knowledge): no reminders from instructions to coding assistants - feat(brief): morning look starts the model only when a build is needed - feat(brief): reminders judge, verify pass, local picker, cards and notifications - test(knowledge): read-failure note carries the error kind only - fix(knowledge): name a source whose read fails in the nightly notes - test(knowledge): set literal in the T3 no-repeat check - fix(draft): timestamped tap detection, preview closes on leaving, re-checked insert, honest clipboard restore - fix(knowledge): per-group Gmail frontiers, T3 open turns and agent prompts, mail order and dedupe, visible read failures - fix(agent): send Claude CLI prompts on stdin, not argv - docs(knowledge): when the runner unloads the local model - fix(knowledge): redact summaries again for the cloud, guard stuck cursors - feat(knowledge): learning engine v2: entities, synthesis, runner and the switch - feat(graph): Knowledge › Graph tab — painter, hover/click/pan/zoom, search, folder chips, side panel - feat(vault): clickable wiki links and a Backlinks section in the reader - feat(knowledge): summary store, local model clients and window triage - feat(graph): graph, layout cache, backlinks and view-state providers - feat(graph): wiki link resolution, graph build and seeded force layout - refactor(knowledge): name window separator widths - refactor(draft): name the native relay arguments and skip reasons - feat(native): calendar snapshot with reminders, sorted and collapsed - feat(knowledge): source windows with two-frontier cursors - feat(draft): native Double Tap detector, context reader, preview and paste - feat(draft): Double Tap drafting service, retrieval, prompt and settings card - docs: Knowledge 2 spec (Sentient OS parity and beyond)
SHA-256: `6b664f2d7abcf010eceee9ed0918c1a7134bdd9f600375a14e55ecc11e7981c5`
